title: PCOS TTC Journey: Finding Clarity With Inito
summary: After a PCOS diagnosis and months of uncertainty, Kayla shares how tracking hormones with Inito helped her better time ovulation and conceive.

*“The truth is, Inito helped us with our timing. God created the miracle living inside me. Today, I’m 26 weeks pregnant with our baby girl, and we’re so excited! If you are on the fence about taking the leap with Inito, don’t…it’s worth it.”*


## Can I Get Pregnant With PCOS?


My fertility journey wasn’t as long as some, and I want to start by saying that I’m rooting for all the moms out there who’ve been trying for years.


I also want to be clear about something upfront: Inito isn’t magic, it’s science, it’s a tool. But for me, it became an important part of a process that had already been filled with uncertainty and unanswered questions.


Like so many women, I struggled to get clear answers from doctors. I’ve been overweight most of my life, diagnosed with[PCOS](https://blog.inito.com/get-pregnant-with-pcos/) , and told more than once that I’d never become pregnant if those things didn’t change.


Read more:[Real Stories of PCOS Insights From 250+ Inito Users](https://blog.inito.com/real-stories-of-pcos-insights-from-inito-users/)


## Living With PCOS and Conflicting Advice


I tried everything I was told to try. I followed different diets, increased my exercise, and even tried appetite suppressants. I did lose some weight, but nothing that felt significant enough to suddenly make our dream feel possible.


Along the way, I used store-bought ovulation tests, but they were confusing and didn’t really tell me much beyond a vague positive or negative. I still felt like I was guessing instead of understanding what my body was doing.


That lack of clarity was frustrating and honestly, discouraging.


## Discovering Inito While TTC With PCOS


In January 2025, after about three months of trying without success, I decided to start using Inito.


For the first time, I got a real glimpse into my reproductive health, something I had never truly had before. Instead of just waiting and wondering, I could see what was actually happening with my hormones. That insight made a huge difference for me.


I didn’t realize it at the time, but just two months later, our lives were about to change.


## When Timing Finally Made Sense


My husband and I found out we were pregnant on April 12, 2025. The first test was so faint that I almost threw it away, convinced it was negative.


I sent my husband, Joshua, out that night to get digital tests. That’s when it finally sank in, I was already four weeks pregnant.


It took a while for it to feel real. After everything we’d tried and all the doubt we’d carried, it was hard to believe that this was actually happening. But I truly don’t think we would have had the same confidence in our timing without the insight Inito provided.


## Navigating Early Pregnancy with PCOS


In the beginning, Joshua and I went to weekly ultrasounds just to confirm that our baby was growing well. A year earlier, I had a front-row seat to my sister-in-law’s miscarriage, and that fear stayed with me.
There’s no real “safe zone” in pregnancy, and that’s one of the hardest parts. I think that’s also why it took me so long to write this review as I didn’t want to jinx anything.
But the truth is this: Inito helped us with timing and God created the miracle growing inside me.


## Closing the chapter


Today, I’m deeply grateful for the journey that brought us here. After months of confusion, mixed messages, and uncertainty around PCOS, having clearer insight into my hormones helped me feel more confident about our timing and more connected to my body.
Inito wasn’t a promise or a miracle, it was a tool that helped us understand what was happening when we needed answers most. For us, that clarity made the process feel less overwhelming and helped us move forward with trust and peace of mind.
